label: Dubstep / Post-Dubstep (UK Bass, Garage-Influenced)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 130-132 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: Intimate and melancholy: the track opens with crackle and a pitched vocal fragment, the 2-step beat enters with a soft sub, the vocal phrases are layered into a haunting hook, a stripped midsection leaves only pad and voice, and a gentler…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female). The vocalist possesses a soft, hushed, slightly husky timbre, heard mostly as pitched and shifted fragments.
cards.palette: A warm sub-bass follows slow minor chords under the pitched vocal samples, with a soft electric-piano-style chord loop in the verses.
cards.tempo_line: written 130 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)

cards.mood: Nocturnal and rolling: an ambient intro with a single chord and crackle, a shuffling beat and a deep sub enter, a pitched sample motif repeats and mutates, and a breakdown with pad and rain precedes a final, fuller groove.
cards.vocal: No lead singer. A few heavily processed vocal fragments, pitched down and drenched in echo, act as ghostly texture rather than lyrics.
cards.palette: A round, warm sub-bass plays a gently syncopated line with long notes, and a pitched, chopped sample acts as the melodic motif.
cards.tempo_line: written 132 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)
